1.0.0: First version: windows, widgets and input for programs in a terminal, laid out in cells, with Kitty or Sixel pictures and a cell fallback.
Checks every state on screen: text and a picture at the smallest size, long and empty data, every mode, keyboard reach and visible focus.
Worked stack: shell windows in Lua on Wippy, checked with the module's harness and live through the app's workshop on a scratch app.
